Welcome back to our latest installment of The Credit Clubhouse, as always I am your host, Todd Anderson, Head of Content & Programming at DealCatalyst. We have a special episode for you today, Bruce Richards at Marathon Asset Management is joined by Kevin Bliss at The Virginia Retirement System to discuss The Convergence of Public & Private Markets. This keynote was recorded at DealCatalyst’s Private Credit Direct Lending Conference on May 12 - 13 in Nashville.  Welcome back to our latest installment of The Credit Clubhouse, as always I am your host, Todd Anderson, Head of Content & Programming at DealCatalyst.

 We have a special episode for you today, Bruce Richards at Marathon Asset Management is joined by Kevin Bliss at The Virginia Retirement System to discuss The Convergence of Public & Private Markets.

 This keynote was recorded at DealCatalyst’s Private Credit Direct Lending Conference on May 12 - 13 in Nashville.

 Key topics covered:

 Key themes across the credit spectrum today GPs and LPs should be aware of when allocating capital Outlook for the volume of liability management exercises in private markets Appeal of hybrid public/private capital structures for a lender vs. a typical private deal as sole or lead lender? As public and private markets converge, should allocators expect premiums in the private markets to come down?  Views on bank distribution partnerships with private credit managers and the regulatory response to this trend Basel III and the appeal/ need for SRT Identifying alpha in a competitive market Bruce Richards, CEO & Chairman, Marathon Asset Management - https://www.linkedin.com/in/bruce-richards-6035771a9/
